_comment: Append newest entries at the top of `updates`. Each needs a unique `id`. Optional `image` is a path under /assets/. Keep entries public-safe: no Pets/Brainrot, no admin-only or subscription marketing.

updates.title: Rivers & lakes in Select
updates.body: Study filters now include rivers and lakes alongside countries, capitals, and flags — turn them on when you set what to practise.

updates.title: Border Crossing: clearer gates
updates.body: The crossing gates now sit below the question sign, so the prompt stays readable while you pick a gate.

updates.title: Hidden secrets & badge case
updates.body: Twelve new secrets to find around LearnGeo, with rewards and a badge case section so you can show what you’ve unlocked.

updates.title: Smoother difficulty sliders
updates.body: Study and game difficulty controls got clearer ticks, a steadier thumb, and a light tick sound when you change levels.

updates.title: Games hub & leaderboards
updates.body: The arcade hub is easier to browse, and every game has a leaderboard so you can see how you stack up.
